newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine leasing, financing seen growing fast.
newsitem.headline: Philippine leasing, financing seen growing fast.

text.p: The leasing and financing sector saw strong growth in 1995 with total loans of 26.9 billion pesos, up 48.6 percent from 1994, a study by PCI Leasing said on Wednesday.
PCI Leasing is a unit of the Philippine Commercial International Bank, or PCIBank.

PCI Leasing said the industry could achieve a yearly average growth rate of 15 percent this year up to 1998 in terms of total portfolio, with the growth fuelled by three major businesses: manufacturing, construction and utility.

It added the growth of the leasing and financing business could also be largely attributed to the rapidly expanding small and medium-sized enterprises which include start-up ventures in the countryside.

The leasing and financing industry was expected to be further boosted by proposed bills relaxing foreign ownership following the opening of the banking industry to foreign banks in 1995, PCI Leasing said.
